_about: Study area and focal species for the wash corridor project. Every script in tools/washes/ reads this file. The box is a draft until Ben confirms it.
bbox_note: North end of the Tucson Mountains (southwest) to Pusch Ridge in the Santa Catalinas (northeast); Grant Road (south) to Tangerine Road (north). 25 x 21 km, 525 km2. Takes in the Santa Cruz, the Rillito, the Canada del Oro and the urban washes of Casas Adobes, Flowing Wells and the Catalina Foothills. Sits inside twelve USGS 1 m elevation tiles.
